== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Medium Transport (Japanese)|Medium Transport]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/159563455/VzZljZGv9UKesRrcRq603g.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 92654383.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>7eb53bc6423966717a2c8cba8dfb59f0bc6d6e0f571a20217ada4e9729f481f9</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
